manifest.name: dsh-dock
manifest.description: One-click desktop launcher for DSH Harness: automatically installs a prebuilt native app (DSH Harness.exe, whale icon) on the desktop when the plugin activates (parameters auto-detected from the environment); the app starts DSH hidden and opens the GUI as a fullscreen Edge app window, and leaves a tray-resident whale with live server status, one-click server restart and optional boot autostart. The sidebar 鲸湾 (Whale Bay) menu (Reload / Restart server / Full exit) renders as a plain sidebar.footer.action neighbor via React portals — no DOM relocation, no hidden native triggers — so it coexists with every other footer-action plugin (including dynamic Cordis plugins) and follows the harness display language; a dsh-dock settings page (tray residency / autostart / extra DSH install paths) lives in the Settings dialog. Candidate discovery is adaptive: it auto-scans every global install the machine exposes — the running Node, roaming npm, WinGet Node versions and nvm-windows version dirs — by probing each unique node's `npm root -g` (v0.6), and lets the user add any custom install path from the settings page (v0.7), so no one ever has to relocate a differently-installed dsh. v0.8: the tray poll cadence adapts to state (1.5s while booting/restarting, 15s steady) and a file watcher delivers the sidebar restart request, Full exit finishes as soon as the host signals disposal instead of waiting out a fixed watchdog, and a restart request is consumed exactly once.

manifest.name: @riceawa/dsh-lan-gateway
manifest.description: LAN/internet reverse-proxy gateway for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: binds 0.0.0.0 and forwards to the loopback dsh web server. Default-deny: every source (loopback, LAN, internet) must sign in with an HMAC session cookie unless lanPasswordless is explicitly enabled; against dsh >= 0.1.2-rc.1 the gateway relays one shared upstream browser session, so the harness's own authorization still gates every request. Fail-closed start guard (password required, plaintext needs an explicit opt-in), session revocation by epoch (password changes and secret rotation kill cookies and live WebSockets), same-site/Origin fence on HTTP and WebSocket upgrades, optional TLS (auto self-signed or user-supplied certs), and a configuration page on the dsh Plugins page (the bundle's own `plugins.bundle.config` slot) for live adjustment of port, CIDRs, auth, TLS, and the login password (the card overwrites the stored credential without ever displaying the old one; the password stays a scrypt hash in state.json, out of the config schema). Includes an insecure-origin UUID shim client bundle: on gateway-served plain-HTTP origins browsers lack crypto.randomUUID, so the client half patches a getRandomValues-backed randomUUID onto the Crypto prototype, fixing workspace open over LAN without touching DSH source.

manifest.name: @riceawa/dsh-lan-gateway
manifest.description: LAN/internet reverse-proxy gateway for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: binds 0.0.0.0 and forwards to the loopback dsh web server. Default-deny: every source (loopback, LAN, internet) must sign in with an HMAC session cookie unless lanPasswordless is explicitly enabled; against dsh >= 0.1.2-rc.1 the gateway relays one shared upstream browser session, so the harness's own authorization still gates every request. Fail-closed start guard (password required, plaintext needs an explicit opt-in), session revocation by epoch (password changes and secret rotation kill cookies and live WebSockets), same-site/Origin fence on HTTP and WebSocket upgrades, optional TLS (auto self-signed or user-supplied certs), and a configuration page on the dsh Plugins page (the bundle's own `plugins.bundle.config` slot) for live adjustment of port, CIDRs, auth, TLS, and the login password (the card overwrites the stored credential without ever displaying the old one; the password stays a scrypt hash in state.json, out of the config schema). Includes an insecure-origin UUID shim client bundle: on gateway-served plain-HTTP origins browsers lack crypto.randomUUID, so the client half patches a getRandomValues-backed randomUUID onto the Crypto prototype, fixing workspace open over LAN without touching DSH source.

manifest.name: opendsh
manifest.description: Open the DeepSeek Harness Web UI inside VS Code. One-click editor title and status bar buttons open a single reusable tab; auto-starts the dsh web server for the current workspace, with a one-command stop.

opendsh.host.description: DSH Web服务器绑定的主机。Host the DSH web server binds to.

opendsh.webviewHost.description: 在VS Code Webview中用于访问DSH的主机。为空则与opendsh.host相同。设置为像'dsh.local'这样的别名（在hosts文件中映射到127.0.0.1）以绕过VS Code对localhost请求的Service Worker拦截，该拦截会导致侧边栏/面板中的Webview空白。仅影响Webview URL；服务器本身仍绑定到opendsh.host。Host used inside VS Code webviews to reach DSH. Empty means same as opendsh.host. Set it to an alias like 'dsh.local' (mapped to 127.0.0.1 in your hosts file) to bypass VS Code's service-worker interception of localhost requests, which blanks webviews in the side bar / panel. Only affects the webview URL; the server itself still binds to opendsh.host.

opendsh.port.description: DSH Web服务器监听的端口。Port the DSH web server listens on.

opendsh.dshPath.description: dsh可执行文件的路径。为空则自动解析（npm全局安装，然后PATH）；未找到dsh时显示错误。Path to the dsh executable. Empty means auto-resolve (npm global install, then PATH); an error is shown when dsh is not found.

opendsh.patchFile.description: 传递给'dsh web'的MCP补丁文件。为空则自动发现工作区中的.dsh/*.patch.yml。MCP patch file passed to 'dsh web'. Empty means auto-discover .dsh/*.patch.yml in the workspace.

markdownEnumDescriptions: 在 VS Code **集成终端**中运行 DSH，随 VS Code 关闭而停止（默认）。Runs DSH in a VS Code integrated terminal; stops when VS Code closes (default).
在**桌面控制台窗口**中运行 DSH，随 VS Code 关闭而停止。Runs DSH in a desktop console window; stops when VS Code closes.
在**桌面控制台窗口**中运行 DSH，VS Code 关闭后**继续运行**（关窗或 Stop 才停）。Runs DSH in a desktop console window; keeps running after VS Code closes (close the window or Stop to stop).

**静默**启动，VS Code 关闭后**继续运行**；可配合 `opendsh.experimental.windowsHidePatch` 抑制工具调用闪窗。Starts silently; keeps running after VS Code closes; can be paired with `opendsh.experimental.windowsHidePatch` to stop tool-call windows from flashing.
opendsh.launch.mode.markdownDescription: DSH 的启动方式（输出载体 × 是否随 VS Code 存活）。启动模式在启动那一刻固定：改动只影响下次启动，请先 Stop DSH（或关窗/关端）再 Open DSH。Launch mode (output carrier × whether it survives VS Code). Fixed at start time: Stop DSH first, then Open DSH again.

opendsh.experimental.windowsHidePatch.description: 实验性功能：仅当启动模式为 'hidden-keepalive' 时，通过集成终端中的命令一次性修补 DSH 源代码（windowsHide），以阻止工具调用窗口闪烁。这会修改 DSH 已安装的源代码，存在风险。默认 false。EXPERIMENTAL: only when launch mode is 'hidden-keepalive', patch the DSH source (windowsHide) once via a command in the integrated terminal to stop tool-call windows from flashing. This modifies DSH's installed source and is risky. Default false.

opendsh.autoStart.description: 在VS Code启动时自动启动dsh Web服务器并打开DSH标签页。禁用则仅在需要时打开。Start the dsh web server and open the DSH tab automatically when VS Code starts. Disable to open on demand only.

opendsh.openWith.description: 打开DSH UI的方式（纯 settings 决定，无面板、无状态记忆）：'tab'（内置单个可重用标签页，默认），'simpleBrowser'（VS Code内置的简易浏览器，每次打开一个新标签页），'systemBrowser'（系统浏览器，地址为http://host:port）。How to open the DSH UI (pure settings, no panel / no state memory): 'tab' (built-in single reusable tab, default), 'simpleBrowser' (VS Code's built-in Simple Browser, one new tab per open), 'systemBrowser' (your system browser at http://host:port).

opendsh.multipleTabs.description: 允许打开多个DSH标签页（每次打开一个）而不是重用单个内置标签页。仅在'opendsh.openWith'为'tab'时适用。所有标签页共享同一个dsh服务器（一个端口）；快速重复打开会被限制以避免意外重复。Allow opening multiple DSH tabs (one per open) instead of reusing the single built-in tab. Only applies when 'opendsh.openWith' is 'tab'. All tabs share the same dsh server (one port); rapid repeated opens are throttled to avoid accidental duplicates.

enumDescriptions: Open in the VS Code editor area

vscode-dsh.startupTimeout.markdownDescription: Maximum seconds to wait for the server to become fully ready. The first run downloads dependencies from npm.

vscode-dsh.workingDirectory.markdownDescription: Launch and default workspace context for the DSH process; it affects the project instructions and `.env` files DSH loads. vscode-dsh.webArgs.markdownDescription: Advanced: extra DSH Web arguments, for example `["--trusted-host", "proxy.example.test"]`. Must not contain the extension-managed `--host`, `--port`, or `--patch`; trusted-host is not authentication.

manifest.description: AiFP Cognitive Memory — persistent memory MCP server for AI assistants. Chinese-first retrieval with causal chains, Hebbian associations and graph diffusion. 记忆感知系统
manifest.readme:
# AiFP 记忆感知系统 — MCP Server

通过 [Model Context Protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/) 为 AI 编程助手提供持久记忆。

[English](./README.en.md) · [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/aifp-mcp) · [GitHub](https://github.com/wjabanjj/aifp-mcp)

让 Obsidian、DeepSeek Harness、Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 等一切支持 MCP 的 AI 工具拥有**跨会话的持续记忆**。完全本地运行，数据不出本机（默认 `~/.ai-cognition/`）。

## 为什么选 AiFP — 一套记忆，所有 AI 共享

你受够了 AI 的"健忘"吗？

- 聊了一上午，它忘了项目名——**存了，但用不上**
- 你说"拍森"，它只认 Python——**说错一个字就搜不到**
- 昨天说 Docker 连不上，今天说 MySQL 连不上，它不知道是同一件事——**相关的记不住**
- DeepSeek Harness 学会的，Claude Code 不知道——**每个 AI 都是记忆孤岛**

多数 AI 记忆系统只是**存**——存是存了，但用不上。AiFP 是让 AI 真正**记住、想通、共享**，把上面这些毛病一次解决。

**先讲别人做不到的（共享）：**

> **一套记忆，所有 AI 共用。** 今天 DeepSeek Harness 学会的，明天 Claude Code 还记得；Codex 攒的偏好，VS Code Copilot 不用重新问。别的记忆系统做不到——因为它们每个各记各的，互不相通。AiFP 让同电脑上所有 AI 工具共用一个大脑，**记一份，处处用**。

**再讲它为什么好用（能力）：**

- **会掂量着记**——不是每句话都存。聊的东西先进"待定区"，由识别器判断这条值不值得长期记住：值得才正式记下，不值得就跳过。不会一股脑全存，也不会错漏重要的。
- **能听懂人话**——你说"拍森"，它知道是 Python；你说"上个月"，它知道是哪个月。说错字、口语、时间词都能理解。
- **能看出关联**——昨天说"连不上数据库"，今天说"改了配置还不行"，它知道是同一件事的延续。还能顺着一条线索联想出相关的内容。
- **记得清，用得上**——一条记忆只留核心意思，不堆垃圾。用的时候只挑最相关的几条给你，又快又不乱。
- **越用越懂你**——你的偏好、习惯它会慢慢积累成"画像"，但它分得清"事实"和"建议"，不会把你的想法和它自己的混在一起。
- **该忘的就忘**——太久没用的记忆会自然淡出，重要的记忆会越来越牢。记忆库永远干净，不会变成堆不动的垃圾场。

**看这些名字，就知道它不简单**——记忆被做成了大脑的结构：

| 概念 | 它到底在干嘛（大白话） |
|------|----------------------|
| 🧠 **海马体 · 记忆感知** | 会掂量着记——先进"待定区"，识别器判断值不值得长期记住，值得才正式记下，不值得就跳过 |
| 🔗 **神经元突触 · 感知链** | 自动发现信息之间的联系，还能顺着线索找到最直接的关系 |
| 👃 **嗅觉皮层 · 语义检索** | 说错也能找到——你说"拍森"，它知道你要找 Python |
| ⚡ **共燃神经元 · 关联** | 一起出现的东西自动绑在一起，问 A 顺带带出 B |
| 🗣 **语言中枢 · 理解** | 懂口语、认错字、认得"上个月"是哪个月 |
| 🌊 **神经扩散 · 联想回忆** | 一条线索能联想出好几层相关的记忆 |
| 🧬 **突触固化 · 记忆巩固** | 用得越多记得越牢，从临时记忆慢慢变成长期记忆 |
| ⏳ **遗忘曲线** | 太久不用的自然淡出，记忆库永远干净不堆积 |
| 📊 **神经信号 · 置信度** | 每条记忆带个"可信度"标尺，越靠谱的越优先给你 |
| 👤 **主人认知模型 · 画像** | 懂你这个人——偏好习惯会积累成画像，但不跟它的想法混 |
| 💪 **肌肉记忆 · 跨轮复用** | 做过的经验跨会话记得，不用每次从头学 |

**天生为中文服务**：认错字、懂口语、认时间词，全都是为中文设计的。英文为主的记忆系统，遇到"拍森找 Python"这种就抓瞎了。

**默认完全私有**：所有数据都存你本机，不上云、不注册、不偷偷上报。所谓"共享"只是多个工具读写同一份本地记忆——**你的数据从没离开过这台电脑**。

**一条命令装好**：`npm install -g` 自动帮你配好 12 个 AI 工具（Claude Code、Cursor、Windsurf、Cline、Gemini CLI、Qwen Code、Zed、VS Code Copilot、Codex CLI、Trae、DeepSeek Harness、pi-coding-agent）。

**一个大脑，多个助手**：今天 DeepSeek Harness 学到的，明天 Claude Code 还记得——像跟一个有记忆的同事说话，不用每次都重新自我介绍。

## 快速开始

```bash
npm install -g aifp-mcp
claude mcp add ai-cognition -s user -- npx aifp-mcp
```

重启 Claude Code 即可使用。数据存在 `~/.ai-cognition/data/cognition.db`。

### DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 自动接入

装完 `aifp-mcp` 后**自动接入 dsh**，无需手动执行任何 dsh 命令：

```bash
npm install -g aifp-mcp
```

安装时会自动检测 dsh 并写入配置（`~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml`）。重启 dsh，记忆工具自动注册为 `mcp__aifp__*`（如 `mcp__aifp__search_memories`、`mcp__aifp__save_memory`），无需手动改任何配置。

### 在任意 AI 对话中安装（推荐）

不需要手动配任何东西。在 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、DeepSeek Harness 等任意工具里直接输入：

> 帮我安装记忆系统：`npm install -g aifp-mcp`

`postinstall` 钩子会**自动检测并配置所有已安装的 AI 工具**（Claude Code、Cursor、Windsurf、Cline、Gemini CLI、Qwen Code、Zed、VS Code Copilot、Codex CLI、Trae、DeepSeek Harness、pi-coding-agent），并打印状态报告。重启工具即可使用记忆工具——AI 看到报告后会告诉你重启哪个，**无需手动改任何 MCP 配置文件**。

> **首次启动**：需要下载 ~30MB 的 bge-small-zh 嵌入模型，最多阻塞 45 秒。后续启动有缓存，秒开。

## 本地模式 vs 服务器增强模式

AiFP 支持两种运行模式（环境变量 `COGNITION_MODE`，默认 `remote`）：

本地模式完全私有（数据不出本机），但**感知链工具需要连接服务器**。服务器地址不随包分发，需通过官方接入渠道获取。

### 拿到 key 后，一条命令连上

> 接入地址和密钥通过官方渠道发放：**联系作者（微信：zm8571806/QQ：8571806/邮箱：8571806@qq.com）订阅后发放**，不随包公开。订阅到期可单独吊销，不影响其他用户。

```bash
# 1. 安装（如未安装）
npm install -g aifp-mcp

# 2. 一条命令连接服务器（地址和 key 由作者发放）
aifp-mcp --connect https://<官方地址> <你的64位key>

# 3. 重启你的 AI 工具（Claude Code / Cursor / dsh 等）
#    感知链 / 深度追踪 / 图扩散自动可用

# 断开（恢复纯本地）：
# aifp-mcp --disconnect
```

`--connect` 会把连接信息保存在本机 `~/.ai-cognition/server.json`，之后启动自动生效，无需每次配置环境变量。

### 更简单：直接让你的 AI 配置

不需要手动敲命令。在 Claude Code / Cursor / Codex / dsh 等任何 AI 工具的输入框里说：

> 这是我的 aifp 服务器地址和 key，帮我配置：
> 地址：https://<官方地址>
> key：<你的64位key>

AI 会自动执行 `aifp-mcp --connect` 并提示你重启工具。重启后感知链增强自动生效。

> ⚠️ key 会出现在对话记录中，介意的话配置完可在管理后台吊销重发（不影响使用）。

### 接入 Obsidian（笔记 ↔ 记忆双向）

**Obsidian 笔记 → 记忆库**（AI 可语义检索你的笔记）：直接让你的 AI 导入，**无需配置环境变量**：

> 把 Obsidian 笔记导入记忆：directory = C:/Users/你/Obsidian/我的笔记库

AI 会调用 `reimport_sources` 同步导入（frontmatter 自动剥离、哈希去重）。以后新增笔记再说一次即可。

**记忆库 → Obsidian 笔记**（在 Obsidian 里看到全部记忆）：让 AI 调用 `export_memories_md`：

> 把记忆导出到 Obsidian：directory = C:/Users/你/Obsidian/我的笔记库/AiFP记忆

导出的笔记带 frontmatter（type/tier/tags），Obsidian 可直接识别和检索；同名笔记自动覆盖更新，保持与记忆库同步。


## MCP 工具（共 33 个）

核心工具（15 个）：

| 工具 | 功能 | 链路 |
|------|------|------|
| `save_memory` | 保存记忆（自动去重 + 向量索引） | 基础 |
| `search_memories` | 双路检索：FTS5 关键词 + 向量语义 | **逻辑链** |
| `recall_context` | 一键回忆（直接命中 + 因果链 + 关联 + 扩散） | **综合链** |
| `get_memory` | 按 ID 获取记忆详情 | 基础 |
| `list_memories` | 分页列出 | 基础 |
| `trace_perception_chain` | BFS 感知链追踪（6 类因果） | **上下链** |
| `find_perception_path` | 双向 BFS 找两条记忆间最短路径 | **关系链** |
| `get_perception_graph_stats` | 感知图统计 | **关系链** |
| `diffuse_memories` | 图扩散搜索（关联多跳） | **关系链** |
| `get_memory_tree` | 层级树结构 | 基础 |
| `get_related_memories` | Hebbian 共现关联 | **关系链** |
| `get_user_profile` | 用户画像——聚合偏好/事实/习惯 | **画像** |
| `observe_turn` | 记录对话轮次到识别队列（跨平台自动记忆入口） | **自动** |
| `reimport_sources` | 重新扫描外部笔记目录 | 导入 |
| `get_stats` | 系统统计 | 基础 |

另有 18 个管理/进阶工具：`consolidate_memories` / `share_memory` / `merge_memories` / `batch_delete` / `batch_update` / `export_memories` / `export_memories_md`（Obsidian）/ `explain_query` / `get_confidence_stats` / `scan_memory_patterns` / `validate_memory` / `get_top_experiences` / `deduplicate_memories` / `scan_observation_patterns` / `rotate_observation_logs` / `session_mine` / `derive_memories` / `flush_recognizer`。

## 跨平台自动记忆识别

Claude Code 使用原生 hooks（100% 自动，零遗漏）。其他工具通过 `observe_turn` 工具 + 指令文件实现（详见 `rules/` 目录）：

| 平台 | 配置方式 | 自动程度 |
|------|----------|----------|
| **Claude Code** | hooks（原生） | 100% 自动，零遗漏 |
| **Cursor** | `.cursor/rules/` 指令文件 | AI 遵守指令时自动触发 |
| **Codex CLI** | `AGENTS.md` 指令文件 | AI 遵守指令时自动触发 |
| **Trae** | 项目规则（手动配置） | AI 遵守指令时自动触发 |

指令文件告诉 AI："每次回答完用户后调用 `observe_turn` 记录本轮消息"。系统会自动判断是否有值得记住的内容，不需手动决定。

## 核心技术

- **SQLite + FTS5** 全文索引（CJK 感知，unicode61 tokenizer）
- **bge-small-zh-v1.5 向量嵌入**（本地 512 维语义搜索，自动重试 + 多镜像回退）
- **Hebbian 共现矩阵**（"一起发射的神经元连在一起"）
- **有向因果链**（6 种关系类型）
- **BFS 图扩散**（沿关联多跳发现间接知识）
- **纠错 + 消歧 + 中文时间词解析**

## 各 AI 工具怎么接入（自动或手动）

`npm install -g aifp-mcp` 时自动完成（postinstall 检测所有已装 AI 工具并写入 MCP 配置）。**以后新装了某个 AI 工具**，跑一次即可接入：

```bash
aifp-mcp --setup   # 重新检测并配置所有 AI 工具
```

自动检测并配置已安装的 AI 工具（检测到才写入，不重复覆盖）：

| 平台 | 配置方式 |
|------|----------|
| Claude Code | `~/.claude/settings.json` → mcpServers + 启动 hook |
| Cursor | `~/.cursor/mcp.json` |
| Windsurf | `~/.codeium/windsurf/mcp_config.json` |
| Cline | `~/.config/cline/mcp_settings.json` |
| Gemini CLI | `~/.gemini/settings.json` → mcpServers |
| Qwen Code | `~/.qwen/settings.json` → mcpServers |
| Zed | `~/.config/zed/settings.json` → context_servers |
| VS Code Copilot | `%APPDATA%/Code/User/mcp.json` → servers |
| Codex CLI | `~/.codex/config.toml` |
| **pi-coding-agent** | 生成扩展到 `~/.pi/agent/extensions/aifp-memory/`（pi 无内置 MCP，用扩展机制） |

## 手动配置

### Claude Code / Cursor

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "ai-cognition": {
      "command": "node",
      "args": ["path/to/aifp-mcp/dist/index.js"]
    }
  }
}
```

### 自定义数据目录

```bash
COGNITION_DATA_DIR=/path/to/data npx aifp-mcp
```

## 环境变量

| 变量 | 默认值 | 说明 |
|------|--------|------|
| `COGNITION_DATA_DIR` | `~/.ai-cognition/` | 数据存储目录 |
| `COGNITION_MODE` | `remote` | `local` 本地保底 / `remote` 连接服务器增强 |
| `COGNITION_SERVER_URL` | *（无默认，须显式配置）* | 远程算法服务器地址（自建） |
| `COGNITION_API_KEY` | - | 远程模式 API 密钥 |
| `COGNITION_RECOGNIZER` | `0` | 设为 `1` 启用自动识别 |
| `COGNITION_LLM_API_KEY` | - | 识别器 LLM 密钥（OpenAI 兼容） |
| `COGNITION_LLM_BASE_URL` | `https://api.deepseek.com` | 识别器 LLM 地址 |
| `COGNITION_LLM_MODEL` | `deepseek-chat` | 识别器 LLM 模型 |
| `HF_MIRROR` | `https://hf-mirror.com` | 嵌入模型下载镜像（失败自动回退 huggingface.co） |
| `CORS_ORIGIN` | `*` | HTTP 模式跨域白名单 |
| `PORT` | `5000` | HTTP 端口 |

## 识别器 LLM 配置（启用自动记忆识别）

观察队列需要 LLM 判断是否值得入记忆，二选一：

```bash
# OpenAI 兼容（推荐：DeepSeek 等）
export COGNITION_RECOGNIZER=1
export COGNITION_LLM_API_KEY=你的DeepSeek密钥
export COGNITION_LLM_BASE_URL=https://api.deepseek.com   # 可选，默认同左
export COGNITION_LLM_MODEL=deepseek-chat                 # 可选

# 或 Anthropic
# export COGNITION_RECOGNIZER=1
# export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-...
```

不配置则只记录观察日志，自动识别不落地（AI 主动 `save_memory` 不受影响）。

Since 0.4.0 the plugin also adds its own download link to the new 0.1.5 surfaces that only open files: a Download item in the delivered-file card's action menu (taking over that caret when a desktop-less Host disables the built-in menu) and a per-row download button in the right Sidebar's file browser. 0.4.1 is a bug-fix release: the 0.4.0 failure toast function was named `notify`, which shadowed the store's own `notify()` in the same bundle scope and made every store update append an empty red toast at the bottom of the page while silencing store subscribers. 0.5.0 makes the whole host half world-agnostic: every workspace read/write/delete now goes through the official filesystem seam (ctx.fs) and the subprocess seam instead of node:fs, so the plugin works identically in a local workspace and in a remote SSH workspace (where the session cwd only exists on the far side); a node:fs fallback is kept for hosts that ship no ctx.fs.

deepseekHarness.url.markdownDescription: Where your running dsh serves `/api`. The extension only attaches: start and manage dsh yourself, independently of VS Code. On startup or connection loss, it tries immediately, then retries every 10 seconds for up to `#deepseekHarness.retryDurationSeconds#`, then stays quiet until **DeepSeek Harness: Reconnect** or a settings change. Local loopback connections authenticate using the existing browser-session record in the configured dsh home. Remote servers can use **DeepSeek Harness: Connect with Launch URL**. Cookies are kept in VS Code SecretStorage.

deepseekHarness.home.markdownDescription: The home of your running dsh, used only to read local authentication. Empty uses `$DSH_HOME` or `~/.dsh`. The extension does not start or configure the server.

deepseekHarness.retryDurationSeconds.markdownDescription: How long, in seconds, to keep retrying transient attachment failures. Retries wait 10 seconds between attempts and stop when this window expires; an attempt already in progress may finish afterward. Set to `0` to disable automatic retries. Afterward, use **DeepSeek Harness: Reconnect** to try again.

deepseekHarness.historyPageMessages.markdownDescription: How many messages each `session.history` call asks for. **This is not a limit on what is restored:** a reopened session is always read back to the first event of its log, however long it is — this only sets how much of it one call carries. dsh counts messages backwards from where the call starts and returns the whole contiguous range behind them, tool calls, results and token-level chunk events included, so lowering this makes each call smaller and a long session take more of them. `50` is dsh's own default.

_comment: =============== dsh-whale-girl-pet（胡桃语音 fork）包清单说明 ===============
type: module —— 本包是 ESM
main: lib/index.js —— 宿主半侧入口（Cordis 插件：name/inject/apply）
lib/usage.js —— 用量与计费内核（价目表 + 事件折叠 + 三桶费用，零依赖）
lib/usage-ledger.js —— 分时段用量账本（北京小时桶 + 日桶、去重、保留窗口），看板数据源
lib/cost-projection.js —— costUsage 会话投影（会话累计 + 每轮金额 + 消息归属）
lib/edge-tts.js —— 角色语音引擎（Edge 神经网络 TTS，自实现 WebSocket，零依赖）
exports['./client'] —— 浏览器半侧入口，DSH 模块系统按它提供 /plugins/dsh-whale-girl-pet/client.js
dsh.bundle.patch —— 声明本包是 bundle，patch 文件是 cordis.patch.yml（安装后自动进层栈）
dsh.client —— 声明浏览器半侧的注入依赖和平台（web）
files —— npm publish 只发这些目录/文件（assets/thumb 播放资源；README.en.md 英文说明）
_original / _fork —— 来源与改动说明（MIT 允许再分发，但必须保留版权声明）
peerDependencies —— 运行时由宿主（DSH）提供的模块，本包不打包它们
manifest.author: yanzwzz

_fork.note: 本包是上游 0.3.2 的本地修改版（MIT 允许，保留原版权声明，改动见 NOTICE.md）
changes: 桌宠大小可调（拖拽把手 + 设置面板），按钮等比缩放并改为鼠标移入才显示
任务播报语音：完成/中断/失败 + 任务名，16 个角色音色（lib/edge-tts.js）
天气 / 余额 / 今日用量改为宿主侧 node:fetch 直连，不再依赖 shell
完成提示改为按回合号去重（原 4 秒时间冷却会吞掉连续任务）
中断判定改用 turn/end { reason.kind: 'aborted' }（原 agent/abort 事件不存在）

_comment_peers: 本包不 import 任何 @deepseek-ai/* 包（宿主侧只用 node 内建 + zod，浏览器侧只 require react），
这些 peer 是'声明式'的：说明本插件绑定的是哪一版 DSH 的服务与槽位契约。
范围必须点名当前 alpha 线：按 semver 的预发布规则，只有范围里存在与目标版本同 patch 的
预发布比较器时，预发布版本才算满足。所以 '^0.1.0-rc.6' 不满足 0.1.6-alpha.2（pnpm 会提示
未满足 peer），每换一条 DSH alpha 线（例如 0.1.7-alpha.1）也要同步更新这里。
分时段看板的历史补扫用 ctx.get('sessionPersistence') 读已落盘会话。
该服务由 @deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl 提供、已随 dsh-base 组合进 web profile，
插件用 ctx.get 可选取得（拿不到就退化为仅实时统计），所以不在此声名为硬依赖。

//test: WHY THE SWEEP IS SCOPED (and who must keep it that way).
1. SCOPE CLOSES A CLASS, NOT A CASE. A bare `node --test` auto-discovers EVERYTHING under a `test/`
directory. On CI runs #19/#20 (`4e2bf5e`, `643ec6e`) that swept in two files that are NOT tests
but MANUAL RUNNERS needing a CLI path: `test/red-401-liveness.mjs` (FAILED, turning the suite and
the whole pipeline red) and `test/proto-runner.mjs` (passed, but silently DUPLICATED the 84 canary
tests). Moving the files would fix today only; scoping `test/*.test.js` means a FUTURE auxiliary
file dropped in `test/` can never take the CI down again — that is the acceptance criterion.
2. THE RUNNERS STAY. Both `.mjs` files are RED EVIDENCE + tooling for CVE-2026-82533 and the canary
prototype; they are NOT deleted. They stay in `test/`, out of the sweep, run by hand as documented
in their own headers.
3. THE FLOOR IS THE `[ -n "$TESTS" ]` GUARD, NOT THE `ls` PREFIX — and the guard is LOAD-BEARING,
not redundant. What stays true: `node --test` with a glob matching ZERO files exits 0 (measured:
`# tests 0`, EXIT=0) — a silent green that would hide a renamed/emptied suite forever. What the
`ls` prefix CANNOT do: it is joined to the terminator by `;`, not `&&`, so the command
substitution's exit status is NOT propagated — `$TESTS` simply arrives EMPTY and `node --test`
runs with NO argument, falling back to its default whole-`test/` tree walk, which is the very
sweep that broke CI runs #19/#20. So the `ls` prefix is not what makes the empty case loud: the
`[ -n "$TESTS" ] || { … exit 1; }` guard is. Measured on the same empty input (an aux `.mjs`
runner present): WITHOUT the guard that runner executed and the run exited 0 (silent green); WITH
the guard it exits 1 and `node` never runs. The guard is the ONLY floor — deleting it because the
`ls` prefix is believed to already protect re-opens the class this script closed.
`test/ghost-guard.test.js` is EXCLUDED BY NAME — it is the RED reproduction artifact of a LIVE class
(the ghost the restart guard counts: `deferDisposeMs` / `whenIdle`; see the file header). Its case at
:123 FAILS ON PURPOSE and goes green only when the ghost is cured where it lives, NOT from this repo.
It is NOT deleted, NOT `.skip`-ped and NOT turned green — it stays executable by hand via
`npm run test:red:ghost-guard`. The other 4 cases in that file are green; the exclusion is per-FILE
because `node --test` filters by file, not by test name.

scripts.test: TESTS=$(ls -1 test/*.test.js | grep -v -F 'test/ghost-guard.test.js'); [ -n "$TESTS" ] || { echo 'FATAL: the scoped sweep matched ZERO test files — refusing to fall through to a bare `node --test`, which would re-enable the whole-test/-tree walk that broke CI runs #19/#20'; exit 1; }; node --test $TESTS

manifest.name: dsh-opencodego
manifest.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: a single provider route 'opencode-go-native' that serves every OpenCode Go (and OpenCode-style OpenAI-compatible gateway) model with the correct wire protocol per model — openai-completions / openai-responses / anthropic-messages — resolved from the models.dev per-model `provider.npm` recommendation and verified against the gateway. Capability facts are NOT assumed: a per-model SYNC asks the gateway which protocols answer, verifies the official reasoning contract (falling back to the full ladder only when there is none), and reads context/output/modalities from a bundled models.dev baseline. The model list is a plain membership list; nothing is enabled until the operator picks it. Credentials live in the host credential store. Dual-face: the host half registers the adapter, the settings section and a narrow diagnostics/discovery/sync HTTP surface; the browser half adds an OpenCode Go page with '获取可用模型' (pick-to-activate) and '信息同步' (per-model capability sync with live progress).

manifest.name: cordis-plugin-novelist
manifest.description: File-backed book ledger tools for long-form fiction, shipped in two host forms from one source of truth. Fifteen deterministic novel_* tools read and write one directory per book: JSON ledgers (project/bible/characters/foreshadows/timeline/outline/status), Markdown manuscripts with per-revision snapshots, an append-only JSONL event log, and an editorial workspace (transaction receipts, per-revision fact snapshots, judge scores, decision log). Chapter submissions are transactional: pending/done receipts bound to a content hash, optimistic concurrency via expected_rev, and an idempotent retry path. Writes to one book are serialized in-process and across processes by a lock file. Also ships an MCP server exposing the same tools to any MCP client (workspace root enforced at boot), a two-role editorial preset for DSH, and a WorkBuddy (CodeBuddy) expert package built from the same host-agnostic capability table (editor-in-chief as lead, author as teammate, tool-face isolation rendered per host into the host's own carrier directory). No runtime dependencies. The code does the bookkeeping; the model does the writing.

O alvo e o ARTEFACTO EMITIDO, nunca o `.ts`: um `bin` a apontar para fonte TypeScript e um symlink que o Node recusa executar. A emissao vem de `tsconfig.bin.json`, terceiro projeto de build — `bin/` nao cabe em `tsconfig.build.json` porque `rootDir` la e `src` e o `tsc` responde TS6059 (medido). O ficheiro so e executavel se `bin/dsh-guard-setup.ts` comecar por `#!/usr/bin/env node`; o `tsc` preserva o shebang mas nao o inventa.
manifest.//scripts: LIMPEZA DETERMINICA NO CAMINHO DO ARTEFATO: `build:all` comeca por `clean` (apaga `dist/` e `lib/`) para que o build compile SEMPRE para uma arvore limpa. Sem isto, artefactos compilados de modulos JA APAGADOS sobreviviam ao `tsc` (que so escreve o que a fonte ainda declara) e iao no tarball publicado — repro da revisao: `dist/worker/providers/discord/**` (8 modulos + sourcemaps do provedor removido, mtimes antigos) entrava no `pnpm pack` e a remocao era falsa no artefato. A defesa em profundidade e o gate do tarball: FORBIDDEN_PREFIXES do `scripts/check-tarball.mjs` rejeita `dist/worker/providers/discord/` e `lib/worker/providers/discord/`; guarda de regressao em test/unit/scripts/release-artefacts.test.ts. SEM `prepare`/`prepack` DE PROPOSITO — hooks de build correm no install de um git-dep e o pnpm 11 bloqueia-os (`ERR_PNPM_GIT_DEP_PREPARE_NOT_ALLOWED` em `pnpm add github:frederico-kluser/dsh-guard-messenger`), que e EXATAMENTE o que impedia o install-by-link (medido: o `prepack` sozinho ja bloqueia; so o `prepublishOnly`, que o pnpm nunca corre para dependencias, resta). O artefacto compilado (`dist/` + `lib/`) e COMMITADO no git — o padrao de `dsh-worktree-jump`, que instala por link sem `allowBuilds` — e `scripts/check-git-install.mjs` prova a instalacao por link de ponta a ponta; guarda de regressao em test/unit/scripts/install-by-link.test.ts. GATE DE FRESHNESS DOS ARTEFACTOS (`check:freshness`, primeiro passo do `package:check`): rebuilda com `build:all` e reprova QUALQUER divergencia dos artefactos COMMITADOS que o build reproduz (`git diff --exit-code dist lib` + `git status --porcelain` vazio: alterado, staged e NOVO EMITIDO PELO BUILD — ficheiros novos que o `git diff` nao mostra). FORA DO ALCANCE do gate, por medicao: um ficheiro criado A MAO em dist/ que o build nao emita e apagado pelo `clean` do `build:all` antes do porcelain e nunca chega ao pacote (o tarball passa pelo clean e o git-dep so serve `git ls-files`) — nao reprova e nao precisa de reprovar. Sem ele, artefactos STALE passavam todos os gates de PRESENCA verdes e o install por link servia o build antigo (repro: mudar uma string em `worker/surface/text.ts` sem rebuild); guarda em test/unit/scripts/freshness-artefactos.test.ts.

manifest.name: dsh-code-server-app
manifest.description: VS Code (from a code-server release) inside DSH: a right-sidebar tab driven by the plugin's own launcher over the in-process VS Code server (lib/launcher.mjs), plus an editor bridge (assets/extensions/dshcs-editor-bridge) that gives the agent what only the editor knows (unsaved buffers, language-server diagnostics, the active selection) and lets editor gestures drive the session. The bridge is completely read-only: all four of its routes (/health, /sync, /old, /event) are reads. Asking DSH from the editor opens a floating dialog inside the DSH page (draggable, resizable, bottom-right): the plugin's client half sends the question as user input (POST /api/code-server/ask/send) and renders that session's new content with DSH's own Markdown renderer - the same @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives instance the UI uses, required from the page's module table, so typography, highlighting and math match the interface and a renderer version mismatch is impossible. Thinking appears as collapsed rows and approval requests (writing outside the workspace / running commands) can be answered in place: whole-plugin write route POST /api/code-server/ask/approve, constrained to pending in-process requests and the outcomes allowed-once/rejected; dialog-first for 5 minutes, handed back to the official card the moment the dialog closes, never auto-approved. There is no build step anywhere: lib/client.js (client half including the dialog panel) and the extension are committed hand-written source, devDependencies holds a single test-only entry, and the published package carries no frontend bundle. Also: the tab claims DSH file addresses (dsh-resource://file/**) by file type (setting claimExtensions), so produced-file chips, delivered-file previews and inline prose mentions open in the workbench; the IDE is a resident surface moved with Element.moveBefore instead of being remounted, so switching sidebar tabs does not reload it; opening the tab switches the right sidebar to fullscreen by default (setting fullscreenOnOpen); a workspace switch re-navigates the workbench with the new ?folder= without restarting the IDE process. Requires a DSH with the right-sidebar services (sidebarRightTabs/sidebarRight, >= 0.1.5-alpha.1); older DSH versions only get an upgrade notice on the settings page. Two serving modes: loopback port (default) or same-origin mount on DSH's own webServer (/code-server, protected by ctx.connection.requestRejection). The diff the bridge opens always has the real pre-write text on the left, taken from result.value.before in tools/post-execute into a bounded snapshot cache and fetched by opaque key over the read-only GET /old, so files that are not open in the editor work too. No code-server Node layer, no argon2, no C++ toolchain.

manifest.name: dsh-llm-auto
manifest.description: DSH 宿主插件:注册一个 `auto` 模型路由,内部按配置的有序链依次尝试多条「provider + model」;某条在**产出任何内容之前**失败时,先按官方同款策略在该路由内原地重试(瞬时错误白名单,默认 5 次),重试耗尽才静默切下一条,对上层表现为一个普通模型;并可用 compactWindow 把自动压缩点钉在指定 token 数附近。0.4.0 起自带浏览器半侧:插件页该 bundle 的卡片上直接渲染配置表单,可直接改 compactWindow(官方 SettingsForm 原语,保存才写入)。0.5.0 起同一处再渲染只读「回退链」面板:当前生效链 + 最近若干次请求的真实回退过程(数据来自 /api/llm-auto/routes,打开页面时读一次、可手动刷新)。0.5.2 起:DeepSeek 原生路由可用 routes[i].keepThinking 保留工具循环思考,缺省仍摘;(B1/B2) 跨路由的历史思考改为从 content 与 replayState.blocks 同步摘掉,不再被上游降级成正文;(B) 真的发生静默路由切换时,在出站消息末尾追加一条与 DSH 自带同款的 model changed 通知(只改出站负载、不写会话记录)。0.5.3 起:新增 routes[i].breakToolLoop —— 历史里存在「带工具调用却没有思考块」的助手消息、且出站以工具结果结尾时,在出站消息末尾追加一条用户提示,把请求改成「以用户消息结尾」,绕开 DeepSeek thinking 模式的工具循环校验(这种情形下思考是「从来没有」,keepThinking 挡不住)。0.6.0 起:routes 成为可写配置,插件页那张卡片上的「回退链」面板升级成可编辑 —— 拖拽排序、从 live 模型目录(新增 GET /api/llm-auto/catalog)里选模型、按行开关 keepThinking/breakToolLoop;写入走官方设置服务落进 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml(注释保留),靠懒读 volatile 引用免重启生效。0.7.0 起:同一张卡片上再多一段**只读**的「额度」摘要 —— 链上两家订阅的余额/窗口用量(Command Code 的美元余额 + 5h/周窗口,OpenCode Go 的 5h/周/月三档百分比),数据来自 /api/llm-auto/routes 新增的 quota 字段;宿主侧只读查询、按 TTL 缓存、永不因此改变端点状态码,**查不到就显示「不可查」而不是 0**;同一个响应里还在确有 profile 覆盖时多一个 user.routes,让面板的「恢复包内默认链」按钮终于有判据可依。0.8.0 起:回退链的顺序改由插件**按订阅额度自动决定** —— 有月度重置时刻的订阅按「越早重置越靠前」排,查不到重置时刻的按配置顺序,永不过期的按量兜底排最后;某一跳因窗口额度耗尽被拒(错误码 QUOTA)时,插件补查该来源的额度接口,确认后把它冷却到对应窗口的重置时刻、期间不再尝试,到点自动恢复(进程内冷却表,不落盘)。新增 volatile 配置键 ordering.mode(auto 默认 / manual = 回到 0.7.0 的「完全按 routes 顺序」),插件页那张卡片上多一段「自动排序」摘要与开关;/routes 响应新增只读字段 ordering(effective 实际尝试顺序 + cooldown 冷却表),chain 仍是配置顺序。0.9.0 起:插件页那张卡片的界面**按排序模式收敛** —— 模式开关(自动/手动)挪到卡片最上面、在「回退链」标题之前;自动模式下主视图是「生效顺序」(插件排出来的实际尝试顺序),可编辑的配置链折进默认收起的「配置顺序」折叠项(点开照旧可拖可改),提示语也换成「自动排序生效中」那句;手动模式下主视图就是那条可编辑的链,不画生效顺序。

manifest.name: @riceawa/dsh-lan-gateway
manifest.description: LAN/internet reverse-proxy gateway for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: binds 0.0.0.0 and forwards to the loopback dsh web server. Default-deny: every source (loopback, LAN, internet) must sign in with an HMAC session cookie unless lanPasswordless is explicitly enabled; against dsh >= 0.1.2-rc.1 the gateway relays one shared upstream browser session, so the harness's own authorization still gates every request. Fail-closed start guard (password required, plaintext needs an explicit opt-in), session revocation by epoch (password changes and secret rotation kill cookies and live WebSockets), same-site/Origin fence on HTTP and WebSocket upgrades, optional TLS (auto self-signed or user-supplied certs), and a configuration page on the dsh Plugins page (the bundle's own `plugins.bundle.config` slot) for live adjustment of port, CIDRs, auth, TLS, and the login password (the card overwrites the stored credential without ever displaying the old one; the password stays a scrypt hash in state.json, out of the config schema). Includes an insecure-origin UUID shim client bundle: on gateway-served plain-HTTP origins browsers lack crypto.randomUUID, so the client half patches a getRandomValues-backed randomUUID onto the Crypto prototype, fixing workspace open over LAN without touching DSH source.

When the threshold fires (or /force-compact queues while busy), the latest `retainLatestTokens` of the conversation's surface tokens are KEPT VERBATIM and everything before that cutoff is COMPACTED INTO A SINGLE SUMMARY NODE in one LLM call (original span entries become shadowed/skipped). Host half is a pure listener; a web client half registers a settings.section (强制压缩 / Force Compact) that reads and writes the same settings namespace.

dshComment: No 'bundle' key on purpose, and its absence is the isolation guarantee.
Declaring 'dsh.bundle.patch' is what makes 'dsh plugin add' append this package to a
profile's 'dsh.profile.bundles', which would apply cordis.patch.yml and give Raven a
host-plane row. That row registers the settings namespace, and a settings page is
global: a user in any other mode would see a Raven card. It also decides the browser
half, because the web app loads a package's client bundle only when the composition
carries a row naming that package.
So installing this package contributes nothing until a session is started in Raven
mode. cordis.patch.yml is still shipped, as an opt-in overlay for a deployment that
wants the card and accepts losing isolation; see the comments in that file.

scripts.check:release: pnpm run check && pnpm run test:pack && pnpm run test:dsh

peerDependenciesComment: Every peer is '*' on purpose, and it is not laziness about ranges.
A profile installs plugins with autoInstallPeers:false and nodeLinker:hoisted precisely so an
out-of-tree plugin's peers fall through to the RUNNING Harness installation and every plugin
shares ONE cordis instance. A narrowed range cannot make a mismatched deployment work: it makes
the install fail, or resolves a second copy whose services the Harness cannot see -- a failure
that looks like an absent service rather than a version conflict. So the range is not where
The 'dshRaven' block at the bottom of this file is. It names the exact Harness version and commit
this build was tested against, scripts/verify-dsh.ts is the executable check of it, and the
release workflow refuses to publish without it. Read the pin, not the ranges, to know what runs.
Consequence to accept: a pre-1.0 prerelease that reshapes a seam gives NO install-time signal here. The
pin plus 'pnpm run test:dsh' against a matching checkout is the only thing that catches it, which
is why that gate is mandatory before a release. See README.md, 'Version pinning and peer dependencies'.

manifest.name: sofagent-monorepo
manifest.description: sofagent 单仓根（monorepo，private 不发布）——开源 FDE Harness 层：嵌在 Agent 与模型层之间做治理，进场把业务判断写成文件（工作流 / 本体数据 / AI 节点），离场按文件审计每一次变更。各能力包在 engine/* 下独立发布（CLI 入口 @sofagent/audit，裸名总包 sofagent）。
manifest.//files: 根包打包边界（v1.4.7 收面批）：private:true 只拦得住 npm publish，拦不住 npm pack / --dry-run。此前既无 files 也无 .npmignore → npm 回退用 .gitignore 排除 → 排除不到 → 实测打过 1621 文件 / 17.3 MB 解包，平铺含 FORGE/ docs/ engine/ tools/ SKILL/ FDE/ .claude/ .cursor/（把内部施工面连同一份含凭证路径说明的配置一起打进 tarball）。本字段把根 pack 收敛到根级必要文件。⚠️ 不影响 @sofagent/* 各 workspace 包（各自 files 独立限定，如 engine/umbrella 恒为 3 文件）；也不影响 install.sh（走 git clone 钉发版 tag，不走 npm pack）。⚠️ 维护注意：根 pack 只用于边界收口，无任何发布/安装链路依赖它——新增根级文件如确需随包分发再显式登记。
manifest.//build-scope: 根 build 覆盖边界（v1.5.1 K4 显式声明，非缺陷）：scripts.build 按拓扑序显式枚举 22 个子命令 = 22 个 workspace 包（其中 engine/dsh-plugins/plugin-kit 以 `npm --prefix` 形态调用而非 --workspace，故仍先于全部 DSH 插件构建——构建拓扑序由本字段手工钉住）。27 项 workspaces 中未被根 build 覆盖的 5 项为：engine/umbrella（无 build 脚本——纯转发壳，bin/sofagent.js 是源码级入口，合理）+ 4 个 engine/openclaw-plugins/sofagent-{audit,evolve,inject,rollback}。⚠️ 后 4 个**各自带 build 脚本但刻意不随根 build 构建**——它们走 OpenClaw 独立分发通道（ClawHub），产物面与根 monorepo 的 npm 发布面相互独立；install.sh 亦不消费其 dist（故当前无故障，属显式声明的潜伏断链收口）。ClawHub 通道构建验证点（v1.5.8 BUG-31 登记）：发版前由维护者在本地对 4 包各跑 `npm --prefix engine/openclaw-plugins/<pkg> run build` 确认零报错 + dist 时间戳更新，随发版阶段九（双分发）取证记录在 devlog（`clawhub build ok ×4` 一行）；ClawHub 上架后的可用性以平台安装回验为准。如需改为纳入根 build、或在文档中另作声明，须先确认分发形态。

manifest.//optionalDependencies: F-18 归属说明：@langchain/anthropic 是 root 级可选依赖，对应编排层 LLM 厂商运行时可选适配器——orchestrator/ab-test 经 @langchain/langgraph 的 createReactAgent（launcher.ts/ab-runner.ts 动态 import）按模型厂商动态加载 ChatAnthropic。源码无静态 import（grep engine/*/src 零命中），仅运行时按需解析；作为 optionalDependency，其安装失败不阻断 build/test，audit 包零依赖。v1.2.1 (commit 295bf26) 加入。结论：保留并在此注明用途，勿删（删之会破坏运行时 Anthropic 模型动态加载）。
manifest.//dependencies: B-3 (v1.4.4) 归属说明：@sofagent/rules 是 root 级声明，实测（临时移除跑 npm install --package-lock-only 对比 lock 面）workspace 态下 node_modules/@sofagent/rules 的 link 条目由 engine/audit、engine/orchestrator、engine/mcp 三个 workspace 消费者维持，root 声明本身零增量语义——但保留声明可让根目录脚本直接 require('@sofagent/rules') 开箱可解析，且对齐 workspace 内部依赖版本对齐原则。勿删（先例：optionalDependencies 同款注释保留）。

manifest.name: dsh-cc-ecosystem

manifest.name: dsh-yolo-mode
manifest.description: dsh-yolo-mode —— DeepSeek Harness 双面包插件：当会话处于可写沙箱模式且审批策略为 ask 时，用大模型自动裁决沙箱升权申请，支持内置预设与自定义权限层级，并提供宿主 settings + 自发布设置桥（/yolo-mode）与 Web 客户端 UI。

manifest.name: dsh-log-memory
manifest.description: Popup-on-open + periodic reminder to save DSH session logs, with in-popup interval (10min-3h), backup folder & format (fish=raw .zstd / human=readable .txt) settings and one-click incremental copy. / 打开 Web 即弹窗 + 定时提醒保存 DSH 会话日志，弹窗内可设提醒间隔（10分钟-3小时）、备份文件夹与格式（鱼话版=原始压缩 / 人话版=可读聊天记录），一键增量复制。

manifest.name: dsh-survey
manifest.description: Questionnaire-style survey plugin for DeepSeek Harness: the do_a_survey tool asks 1-10+ questions at once (single/multi/yes-no/compare/open types) in four presentation modes (compact/inline/overlay/grid), with per-question skip, full Markdown & color rendering, and a two-column recap after submit. Bundle form resident in the Web profile; companion skill ships a dynamic-plugin fallback recipe.

manifest.name: dsh-knowledge-graph

manifest.name: @dsh-external/project-nav
manifest.description: DSH plugin: architecture-first project governance, FOR AGENTS ONLY. v0.12.0 made governance PRESENT instead of merely callable: the three persisted projections (PROJECT.md marker section / .internal/ARCH-MODEL.md / HTML map) are gone — their only reader was a human — and governance moved into the agent's context via a presence layer. v0.12.1 collapses that layer to a SINGLE injection path: the `systemPrompt.section` whose text is a FUNCTION evaluated every turn. The second path (tools/post-execute + additionalContexts) was removed because it was pure duplication (the per-turn section already carries the latest governance; measured 24 duplicate inbox injections / ~31KB in a real session log) AND because it was the only thing that created a message — and a message's `source` is load-bearing (a missing one makes a downstream `agent/pre-step` read `source.kind` of undefined, throwing and turning the whole turn into `turn/end {kind:'error'}`). The section never creates a message, so deleting that path removes the entire failure class rather than patching one instance of it. Output is zero-on-disk: nav_graph computes on demand and the presence layer injects, both pure derivations of the model. The presence layer reads ONLY the event-log fold (measured 5.1ms vs 177ms for the full disk-scanning buildModel, 35x), never writes runtime/, and refuses to report disk facts it did not compute. Data plane 2 layers, tool face 5 (nav_render retired with the projections). The model is a TREE + GRAPH — the containment tree (who belongs to whom) sits beside a dependency graph (who imports whom) DERIVED from a static import scan: never registered, never hand-written, never stale. Seven gates (anchor / scope / mainline / impact / repeat-patch / decision / completion) are pure queries inside the single write entry point nav_commit, so there is no begin/done lifecycle and no orphan state: closure is decided by EVIDENCE (did the scope files change?), never by session identity — kill a session and its intent still closes (A1). ONE append-only event log (.internal/events.jsonl) is the single source of truth; the runtime model (incl. the dependency graph) is disposable — delete runtime/ and governance loses nothing (I3). Tool face 5: nav_graph (read, incl. mode=impact / mode=json) / nav_commit (intent) / nav_decide (ADR) / nav_node (nodes) / nav_set (mainline vector).

The personas reach the profile through the tavern content repo instead: @ai4rpg/dsh-tavern-preset depends on @ai4rpg/tavern-agents via a file:../tavern-agents spec that stays inside that self-contained repo, pnpm hoists the content package into the profile's node_modules, and resolveAgentsDir() finds it from here with createRequire. TAVERN_AGENTS_ROOT overrides the resolution for tests, and the real-package tests skip when the package is unresolvable: this repo deliberately carries no file: devDependency, so a fresh clone resolves nothing; install the content package from a local checkout without saving it (npm i --no-save <tavern-content>/tavern-agents) to re-enable them. stage-switch rides as a real dependency (not a peer) because dsh-base does not provide it: downstream deployments resolve it from this package's install, and autoInstallPeers is false in DSH profiles.

scripts.test: node test/validate-preset.mjs && node test/smoke.mjs && node test/host.mjs && node test/client.mjs

manifest._uiPanelNote: 右下角胶囊悬浮窗：平常是一颗带「术数合盘」文字的胶囊，点开是面板。**懒人化（task-21 重构）：一屏一问一答，结论优先，细节默认收起** —— 顶部只有一个输入框（所问之事，回车即起卦、Esc 清空）；provider / model / 思考强度 / 联网 / 重出判词 全部收进「高级」折叠区，默认取配置默认值，不打开也能用；定位（浏览器 navigator.geolocation）自动执行、不让用户点。结果区自上而下：① 大字总断（吉/平/凶 + 分门加权分 + 一致性/置信小字）→ ② 一句话白话结论（AI 判词的「一句话收束」；无判词则退回合盘 advice 首句，骨架写死在 src/index.js 的 INTERPRET_SYSTEM）→ ③ 三行要点（五行 / **跨门共识，显示 N法/M门** / 应期）→ ④ 提示条一行（⚠近似法数 · 未起法数 · 位置与是否真太阳时校正 · 随机模式或 seed 复现 · seed，可点开看逐条）→ 按钮行（**再占一次**（默认随机模式：重问本就可能是新结果，面板不承诺一致）+ 复制结论 + 复制 seed）→ ⑤ 五个默认收起的折叠块（108 法明细（点行下钻）/ 分歧（含 D1–D5 等级与 reason）/ 分类加权 / 出处账本 / 完整 AI 判词）；右上角「清空」清空页面并清服务端内存记录。折叠用 display:none 实现（内容始终在树里，切换不丢状态，压力测试仍真的渲染 108 行）。求占时刻取这台机器的当前时间；经度取不到时如实标注「未做真太阳时校正」，绝不臆造。联网**不做 tool-call 循环**（消息体形状无类型声明可核对，猜错会被适配器抛错），改宿主侧直接检索。**关键前提**：本包必须在 profile 的 dsh.profile.bundles 里，且 cordis.patch.yml 里有一条**顶层**插件行——@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-modules 的宿主半边只扫『enabled Loader entries』（顶层条目）组合启动图，挂在 preset 里的**嵌套行它扫不到**，dsh.client 永远不会被服务成浏览器 bundle（胶囊长期不出现的根因）。immediately: true 让它在启动时就加载；**改完 lib/client.js 需先刷新页面（F5）**，若仍旧面板则重启宿主后再刷新。旧 agent preset 仍在 patch 里但已 disabled: true。

manifest.name: @jipika/dsh-memory
manifest.description: Progressive long-term memory for DSH: sharded markdown bodies under ~/.dsh/memory/topics/, with only a live-generated map (shard · keywords · count · latest date) injected into the system prompt, entries pulled on demand via grep + read — so the prompt cost stays flat however large the memory grows. Two layers (global + per-project) plus the global rule files, viewable AND editable in DSH Settings, with per-layer switches and an index/full injection toggle. v0.5.0 adds enforcement hooks: a write guard on the native tool pipeline (format/secrets/history rules, optional external command judge, deny/ask with reasons fed back to the model), post-write audit log, a read reminder when memory files are read, a mandatory discipline block, and an optional injection filter command. Zero extra LLM cost, live re-read. v0.5.1 keeps the switches in ~/.dsh/memory/settings.json — read live by the plugin and edited from the settings pane over the plugin's own route, independent of the host settings API. v0.6.0 fixes the index silently degrading to a title-less directory once memory outgrew the hardcoded 9k budget (which is why an agent could see memory injected and still never read it): the index now shrinks per-shard along a newest-N-per-shard ladder under a configurable indexBudget, adds per-shard keywords (routing hint) and latest-entry dates, ships a 'check memory before starting a task' discipline, and makes full mode read the shard bodies (auto-falling back to index when over budget) instead of the retired memory.md navigation file. v0.7.0 makes 'map' the default injection mode (shard-level map only, no entry titles): retrieval = grep the memory dir with task keywords, then read the matched line; layers with <=12 entries stay inlined; the discipline block teaches that two-step path and routes cross-shard lookups (>=3 entries / >=2 shards / >=3k body) to a subagent that returns facts + line numbers instead of raw bodies.

manifest.//exports[typert]: 官方 Typert 自动发现入口：@deepseek-ai/dsh-typert-loader 启动装配时读 exports["./typert"]，导入它并校验 mod.TYPERT（package 必须严格等于包名、face 必须是 'host'），然后 ctx.typert.register(manifest)。生产可用的 dsh-mcp-panel 就走这条。缺了它就只能靠插件自己手工注册 —— 真机上出现过「$mount 报成功但命名空间始终不出现」，所以这条是主路径。
manifest.//files: 只发布运行源码、配置、工作流配置 skill、README 和许可证。本地资料、开发记录、测试与开发脚本不入包。
manifest.author: 锦瑟 <https://github.com/achenjins>
manifest.//peerDependencies: 只声明 peer，**绝不写进 dependencies**：DSH 的 dsh-app-boot 对 link 进来的插件做 peer 感知的解析拦截（routeLinked + readPeerNames）—— 只要这里点名的包，导入就会被路由到**运行时自己那一份**，从而保证 `defineTool` / `schemastery` / `TypertRemoteService extends Service` 的模块身份与宿主一致。写进 dependencies 会让 pnpm 真装一份物理副本，反而可能变成两份实例。范围故意放宽（`>=0.1.0-0 <0.4.0`）以覆盖 0.1.x / 0.2.x 两条线，避免版本不匹配导致插件被跳过加载。
manifest.//scripts: **故意没有 prepare / postinstall**。本插件是手写 ESM、零构建步骤，所以从 git 安装时不需要任何构建脚本 —— 用户因此**不必**做 pnpm ≥10 的 `allowBuilds` 授权（那条授权等于允许本包在安装时于本机执行代码）。一旦这里加上 prepare/postinstall，那个坎就会立刻出现。
manifest.//concurrency: 测试**必须串行**跑（`--test-concurrency=1`）：默认并行时每个测试文件各起 HTTP server，机器一忙定时器被饿死，定时器相关的断言会间歇假红 —— 实测同一份代码出现过「1 红 / 6 红 / 全绿」三种结果。验收门要的是确定性。

manifest.author: yanzwzz
_comment_peers: 本包不 import 任何 @deepseek-ai/* 包（宿主侧只用 node 内建 + zod，浏览器侧只 require react），
这些 peer 是'声明式'的：说明本插件绑定的是哪一版 DSH 的服务与槽位契约。
范围必须点名当前 alpha 线：按 semver 的预发布规则，只有范围里存在与目标版本同 patch 的
预发布比较器时，预发布版本才算满足。所以 '^0.1.0-rc.6' 不满足 0.1.6-alpha.2（pnpm 会提示
未满足 peer），每换一条 DSH alpha 线（例如 0.2.0-rc.1）也要同步更新这里。
分时段看板的历史补扫用 ctx.get('sessionPersistence') 读已落盘会话。
该服务由 @deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl 提供、已随 dsh-base 组合进 web profile，
插件用 ctx.get 可选取得（拿不到就退化为仅实时统计），所以不在此声名为硬依赖。

manifest.name: @mrweicodes/dsh-loop-guard
manifest.description: Thinking-loop guard for dsh: observes the llm/stream waterfall and breaks a model that degrades into a loop. Detects two per-call shapes (reasoning-only calls, restated-material calls) and re-fires instead of latching; plus two mid-stream breakers that end a single degenerate call (maxRepeatedText / maxRepeatedCycleChars for visible output, maxRepeatedReasoningCycleChars for a reasoning bleed), which no post-call detector can reach — the reasoning rule is what ends the never-finishing turn of issue #5976. Ships an offline session analyzer that replays a session jsonl through the same detector. Compatible with every published dsh line from 0.1.2-rc.1 through 0.2.0-rc.1.

_comment: 插件的真实包在 src/：那里才有 lib/（宿主半侧 + 浏览器半侧构建产物）、assets/（106 个 webm）和 cordis.patch.yml。
为什么根目录也声明 dsh.bundle —— 一批目录/工具只把『仓库根』当成安装目标，会生成
dsh plugin add github:12we21/cute-fat-fish-pet
（dshbase 的 gen-catalog.py、bradeGithub/DSH-Plugins-Marketplace、ukinch605/awesome-dsh-hub 的收录条件、
以及 dshfind 的 is_plugin 判定都是这个口径）。根清单没有 dsh.bundle 时，这条命令装不上任何东西，
仓库也会被判成「不是插件」。子目录指向（#path:/src）依然有效，两种装法并存。
main / exports 一律指向 src/ —— src/lib/index.js 里 PACKAGE_ROOT = resolve(new URL('..', import.meta.url))
是模块相对解析，所以无论从仓库根装还是从 src/ 装，assets/ 都能找到。
本清单不参与 Electron / NSIS 打包；打包入口是下面的 scripts（node build/build.mjs 等）。

manifest.//peerDeps: 运行时由 DSH 宿主提供，插件不依赖自己那份（否则会出现两套库实例）。
manifest.//devDepsNote: 下面三个 @deepseek-ai 包放在 devDependencies 里并**钉死精确版本**，有两层原因：(1) 本地跑测试与类型检查时需要有它们；(2) 版本必须与 DSH 自带的那份逐位一致 —— cordis 的服务注册依赖真实实例身份，两侧版本分叉会出现极难排查的「两套实例」故障。所以这里是精确版本而不是范围，改之前先确认 DSH 用的版本。

client.//why: 宿主半区会扫描 Loader 条目里的这个声明，把 lib/client.js 作为浏览器 bundle 通过 /plugins 提供。没有它设置界面里不会出现本插件 —— DSH 的设置页是客户端渲染的，宿主侧注册设置命名空间只让值可读写，不会自己长出界面。
client.//inject: dsh-api-remotes 是 0.2 起的必需项：设置页的读写都走 ctx.remote.settings（旧版的 settingsScope 服务已被整个移除），不声明它就拿不到 remote。

scripts._comment:test:plugin: DSH_PROFILE_DIR= = 测试隔离铁律：本套件跑在 DSH 宿主里时环境**天然带着** DSH_PROFILE_DIR（指向真实 ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop），而多数用例只隔离了 HOME —— 于是它们会去写**真实** profile 的 cordis.patch.yml（2026-10-10 故障：测试 relayDir 被写进真 profile，面板连到假配置、验证码/公告全 502）。这里显式清空，让 profile 解析回落到各用例自己的假 HOME。 DSH_RELAY_BUNDLED_RUNTIME=/nonexistent = 强制走 npx 兜底分支（否则本机跑过 npm pack 后 packages/dsh-remote-web/runtime 存在，用例会改成走本地拷贝）。DSH_RELAY_SKIP_SERVICE=1 = 测试隔离：插件加载时不做真实系统操作（npx 补装 / launchctl / 重启 harness）；需要真实分支的用例自行 unset（见 account-switch / runtime-provision / harness-restart 用例注释）。DSH_RELAY_DEFAULT_API= 死端口：用例拆掉临时目录后，仍在飞的后台请求（装机上报重试等）会读到空配置并回落「默认云端地址」—— 指到本地死端口才不会打生产。

manifest.name: @dsh-agent/dsh-agent-memory
manifest.description: Agent-facing memory layer (increment 1, I1 foundation + I1.2 scoring calibration + I2 residual-pyramid triage): four narrow tools (remember/recall/expand/prune) over a human-readable NDJSON store with a fail-closed write protocol, atomic writes, hard caps with score-based eviction, and zero runtime dependencies. I1.2 scoring: BM25 with per-field statistics, absolute-scale display (no batch normalization), VCP-style tag coverage as a diagnostic column, and MMR diversity multiplied into the printed score. I2 triage: a Gram-Schmidt residual pyramid over the tag-idf lexical space (novelty = 0.7*residualRatio + 0.3*directionConsistency) decides whether recall widens kBase -> kExpanded; all pyramid state is request-local (no module-level cache), and low confidence is only reported, never used to veto. I4a: two query-independent injection contributions sharing a single injection.enabled switch — a trailing runtime-context block (ctx.systemPrompt.context({name:'agent-memory', order:200, text})) carrying the library index (count + what the store is + a conditional rule + qualified tag anchors, changing only when the store changes, hard maxChars budget with an honest omission marker) and, since I4a.3, a stable section (ctx.systemPrompt.section({name:'agent-memory-habit', order:3200})) carrying that same conditional rule inside the stable prefix; since I4a.4 that stable text also carries the scope convention (write project-specific records as scope: project:<name>, cross-project ones as the default global) while the plugin never infers the workspace; the rule is honestly a prompt nudge, not a guarantee, and there is no automatic topical recall — only the index line and the rule enter context, so memory content still requires an explicit memory_recall call; both contributions fail open on any read/parse/registration error (never throws), and the index keeps an idempotent read-only cache keyed strictly by {path, size, mtimeMs}. I4a.1: `inject` is narrowed to ['tools'] and the injection surface is registered conditionally via ctx.inject(['systemPrompt'], scope => scope.systemPrompt.context(...)) — a missing systemPrompt costs only the injection line, never the four tools (the old hard dependency made the whole plugin skip apply()). I3: an ordered bidirectional tag co-occurrence graph built per call from the current store (directed counts kept separate per direction, log(1+lambda*W) compression instead of linear accumulation, per-node outflow normalised to a fixed budget, hub suppression (inDegree/median)^-eta), plus bounded pulse propagation (maxHops/maxStates/maxFieldNeighbors, decay gamma, immediate backflow suppression rho) that adds a capped auxiliary reward graph <= GRAPH_BONUS_CAP to the ranking (final = rel + graph, rel stays the BM25 score that decides match); no module-level mutable state that affects request results (the only one is src/store.ts's tmpSeq, which names atomic-write temp files and never enters recall/scoring/injection), propagation is request-local, and the injection line is untouched. I4a.2: anchor selection now applies an occurrence-rate qualification filter first (a tag on more than ANCHOR_MAX_DF_RATIO = 0.3 of records, configurable via injection.anchorMaxDfRatio, can never become an anchor), then ranks the qualified set by document frequency desc with a code-unit tie-break; fewer than topTags anchors is reported honestly and a corpus whose tags all fail the filter gets an explicit 无可区分锚点 line instead of falling back to the most frequent tag. I2.2: the offline calibration script now draws its negative samples from a frozen, corpus-independent cross-domain vocabulary (scripts/negative-samples.mjs, zero-argument deterministic generator) so the set grows from 12 hand-written queries to 240, and it prints a sensitivity comparison that puts the 12-sample estimate (the old script's own sample) side by side with the full-set estimate, which is what SCALE_A = p50(negatives) and WEAK = p95(negatives) actually rest on. Still print-only: it never writes any file or config, and an empty store exits 0 with a readable hint. I5/修正1: the memory_recall L1 header is a single line whose total length is bounded by HEADER_MAX_CHARS = 448 characters, and that bound holds by construction for ANY query string: the fixed part echoes the scale constants through formatHeaderConstant at a bounded width (an over-wide value is rendered as an approximate value marked with a leading ≈; the exact value stays in the structured scaleA/scaleB/weakThreshold/strongThreshold fields) and the query= echo is bounded by formatHeaderQuery, which truncates the raw query BY CODE POINT FIRST and JSON-escapes only afterwards (so escape sequences are never cut) and marks truncation honestly with …(截断). The old 'single line of <= 400 characters' claim had only ever been measured on three short-query fixtures (388~399): a 200-character query containing quotes/backslashes/newlines measured 742 characters and a 360-character one 932, and a 22-decimal scaleB pushed the fixed part to 413 on its own. It keeps only what is needed to recompute the printed judgement (column order, rel semantics + the two match thresholds, score=disp(final) with both scale constants, limit as the hard display cap, the I2 conclusions novelty/threshold/expanded/kBase->kUsed, the low-confidence cov_max/activation threshold, and the I3 conclusions final=rel+graph / graph bonus cap / graph size / hub-suppressed count / reachable); non-conclusive diagnostics (basisSize/layers/logicalDepth, the explainedRatio+residualRatio conservation, propagation limits/gamma/rho, seed-and-arrival counts, diversity beta) are no longer echoed in the header and remain exact structured fields. The old 1049~1066-character header (measured on this device; evidence: redproof/i5-header-old-measure.txt and i5-header-red.txt) fit only 7~9 rows under RECALL_MAX_CHARS=2000 and echoed the scale constants themselves, so retuning SCALE_A/SCALE_B/WEAK/STRONG used to change how many rows were displayed; test/header.test.mjs now pins that the number of displayed rows (and the truncated flag) is identical across scale configurations. I6.2/I7: the L1 column list is now the single source of truth for four places at once (formatL1's cell-table key order via the exported recallCells, the L1Row field order, the output schema's rows.properties key order, and the actual serialized row key order), all pinned at runtime by test/columns.test.mjs (a schema or cell-table key moved back to the pre-I3 order turns it red), while the printed lines stay byte-identical (verified against the pre-change build over a fixed corpus: 7/7 query/config cases produce identical lines and identical row values, only the header text and the row key order change). The memory_recall description and the L1 header now state the true score formula: final=(rel+graph)×diversity factor, where the factor (1-beta*maxSim, beta=0.3) is applied only when the candidate count is > 5, together with the honest consequence that a diversified score cannot be recomputed from the printed rel/graph alone (beta and maxSim are not printed columns) while match always can be recomputed from the printed rel plus the header thresholds; the header also states the graph/via column semantics, and the old 'no evidence => rel/score are 0.0000' wording is replaced by the precise version (no lexical evidence => rel=0; graph-only arrivals have graph>0 and via=tag:<label>, and their score depends on the scale constants - 0.0000 by default only because SCALE_A 0.0199 exceeds GRAPH_BONUS_CAP 0.018). 修正2: the memory_recall tool description is slimmed from 1182 to 266 characters (<= 300), keeping only the ten-column list (still derived from RECALL_COLUMNS), one rel/match/score sentence, limit as the hard display cap, the never-returns-body rule, and a pointer to docs/recall-contract.md; every detail removed from the description moved verbatim into that document, and test/description.test.mjs pins both layers (the description for length <= 300 plus the five essentials, the document for the moved details) so that the pointer cannot lie. The engine's deferLoading marker IS supported (defineTool option: @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools/lib/index.js:864, type lib/types/schema.d.ts:194-195) but is deliberately NOT adopted: it is a session tool-update mechanism (route ToolUpdate, dsh-llm/lib/types/types.d.ts:365-374; projectToolUpdates dsh-llm/lib/index.js:786-834) and an explicitly deferred baseline tool stays deferred until its first retained tool-addition block (dsh-llm/README.zh.md:162), which for these boot-registered tools would mean the model never sees memory_recall at all. test/graph.test.mjs adds the graph-arrival invariant (returned, rel=0, graph>0, via=tag:, match=none, score === absoluteDisp(rel+graph)).

scripts._comment:test:plugin: DSH_PROFILE_DIR= = 测试隔离铁律：本套件跑在 DSH 宿主里时环境**天然带着** DSH_PROFILE_DIR（指向真实 ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop），而多数用例只隔离了 HOME —— 于是它们会去写**真实** profile 的 cordis.patch.yml（2026-10-10 故障：测试 relayDir 被写进真 profile，面板连到假配置、验证码/公告全 502）。这里显式清空，让 profile 解析回落到各用例自己的假 HOME。 DSH_RELAY_BUNDLED_RUNTIME=/nonexistent = 强制走 npx 兜底分支（否则本机跑过 npm pack 后 packages/dsh-remote-web/runtime 存在，用例会改成走本地拷贝）。DSH_RELAY_SKIP_SERVICE=1 = 测试隔离：插件加载时不做真实系统操作（npx 补装 / launchctl / 重启 harness）；需要真实分支的用例自行 unset（见 account-switch / runtime-provision / harness-restart 用例注释）。DSH_RELAY_DEFAULT_API= 死端口：用例拆掉临时目录后，仍在飞的后台请求（装机上报重试等）会读到空配置并回落「默认云端地址」—— 指到本地死端口才不会打生产。

manifest.name: source-code-mgmt
manifest.description: DSH plugin: source code management. Registers「代码管理」as a card in DSH's OWN right sidebar (the official guide page, beside 工作区文件 / 新建终端 / 浏览器) and as a tab page in that column — there is no separate button. Older hosts degrade gracefully: dsh-better-sidebar (if installed) gets a Tab; a host with neither gets a header entry (beside "Session log", plus a same-height pinned one in the empty state). Nothing is ever placed in DSH's own left sidebar. The SSH section lets you choose port 443 (through firewalls that block 22) or the standard 22, and switching rewrites ~/.ssh/config in place. Repo status batches its git calls (one numstat for all changed files, one `remote -v` for name+URL), cutting a load on a busy repo from ~1.3s to ~0.06s. Opens a panel with env checks (git/gh), SSH ed25519 key setup, GitHub/Gitee dual-platform (SSH config + Gitee OpenAPI), connectivity test, push / new repo, auto-ignore files over 100MB with per-file skipped reasons, a clone section (remote repos from your account with local-exists detection, plus clone any repo by URL into any location), and a five-step npm publish wizard. Cross-platform (Windows / Linux / macOS).

permissions.filesystem: dsh-anagenesis owns $DSH_HOME/anagenesis/ (journal/*.jsonl append-only log + snapshot.json). For read compatibility with the pre-rename layout it will ALSO open $DSH_HOME/evolution/ when the new directory does not exist yet, and it never moves that data on its own — `tools/migrate-store.mjs` does the copy and only when the operator runs it. It reads and writes nothing else; it never opens another plugin's memory store. The visualization row only reads that store, and `tools/viz-watch.mjs` is a standalone read-only viewer the operator runs themselves — the plugin never spawns a process. The `anagenesis` preset row may also write $DSH_HOME/.agent-presets/anagenesis/ on hosts that still discover presets as directories, and removes exactly the files it created when unloaded.
permissions.subprocess: none — no shell, no network, no model calls

disclosure.retention: local-only journal under $DSH_HOME/anagenesis; memory deletion is explicit via ana_forget/ana_expire and is itself journaled. Compaction appends archive segments and by default keeps every seq revertible; the optional retainEvents policy (default 0 = off) may prune whole archive segments, and any such loss is recorded in journal/pruned.json and reported by ana_audit view=status

manifest.comment:peerDependencies: Required by the DSH loader, not a runtime dependency. For a `link:` install the plugin is reached through a symlink, so Node resolves bare specifiers from the plugin's real on-disk location, where no harness packages exist; app-boot only intercepts a linked package when the plugin itself declares that peer (readPeerNames at lib/types/profile-resolution/resolver.js). Omitting these makes the plugin fail to load with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND on @deepseek-ai/schemastery. Nothing is installed from them: the profile sets autoInstallPeers=false and the harness supplies both packages.

manifest.name: dsh-plugin-cicd
manifest.description: 发布台（Release Console）for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar entry and a full main-panel page that show what each repository has built, what it has released, whether the local checkout is ahead of the release, whether the copy installed in this profile is the published artifact, and which version npm holds. 发布 is one press that does the whole release (发布同台): push the code, bump the version when the workflow would refuse it, dispatch release.yml asking for a draft, wait for that run, push npm, then make the draft public, then announce on Bilibili. The order is the feature — an npm publish is irreversible and a draft is not, so a refused npm push leaves the Release unpublished and the pipeline can be resumed, or the Release published without npm. The separate buttons remain for a repository whose release must stay a draft. It also carries the third channel: when a release goes public, one short update note is posted under the video that introduces the plugin, with the credential obtained from a Bilibili sign-in inside the panel. Reuses the machine's authenticated gh CLI and the Host's own package manager, so the plugin stores no GitHub or npm credential of its own; the one credential it does own is the Bilibili session it created, kept in its own directory and never echoed back.

meta.title: DSH 插件发布台
meta.description: 面向 DSH 插件仓库的持续构建与发布（CI/CD）：侧边栏图标 + 独立主面板，显示每个仓库的最近一次运行、已发布的 Release、本地是否领先于发布、本 profile 装的到底是哪一份（link: 本地检出 / Release 的 tgz），以及 npm 上是哪一版。浏览器登录、勾选仓库即可，复用本机已登录的 gh 与 Host 自己的包管理器，不另存 GitHub / npm 凭据。【发布】是一键发布（发布同台）：提交并推送代码 → 升版本（必要时）→ 触发 release.yml 取草稿 → 等 CI 成功 → 推 npm → 公开 Release → B 站播报，顺序不可换——npm 推送不可逆而草稿不是，所以 npm 失败时 Release 留在草稿、对外全有或全无，补上原因（如 2FA 一次性密码）即可继续，也可以选择跳过 npm 只公开 Release。装 Release 后面板接着问要不要重启（转发给 dsh-plugin-restart）；未登录 npm 时可在面板里粘贴 token 写入 npm 自己的 .npmrc。第三条渠道是 B 站更新播报：Release 公开后，在绑定的视频评论区自动补一条简短的更新说明——只认已公开的 Release（草稿不算），按 (仓库, tag) 幂等，绑定视频时写入基线所以不追发历史版本；凭据走面板内的 B 站登录（passport 网页二维码）或粘贴一次，落在插件自己的目录里、不回显，并且会真的去问一次账号接口——因为 biliup 默认写下的 cookies.json 是 BiliTV 登录，发评论走的却是 Web 接口。门禁与产包形状按 DSH bundle 设计（契约检查 + 整树 zip + 可安装 tgz + npm），任何带 ci.yml / release.yml 的仓库都能接。

manifest.name: dsh-repeat-tool-breaker
manifest.description: Requires dsh >= 0.1.7 (session format 4); on dsh 0.1.5 use dsh-repeat-tool-breaker@0.7. Escalating repeat detection for dsh: a synchronous ctx.tools.guard gate that counts semantic fingerprints (exact/cmd/net/host/sink) over a per-agent sliding window, warns at 7, demands a progress summary at 11, and gates at 12 (16 for the coarser host: measure), plus a second track on consecutive failures (advisory at 3, block at 5) — asking the operator for a turn-scoped exemption instead of only blocking. Also refuses shell HTTP and redirects the model to a web_fetch_file tool that saves the page and returns its path, and ships a Settings → Plugins card for the block policy and the stage thresholds.

Six were non-breaking and lifted an earlier npm audit to zero: hono (cross-request data disclosure / ReDoS / SSRF-adjacent parser issues), @hono/node-server (Windows path traversal via encoded backslash), body-parser (DoS when an invalid limit silently disables size enforcement), fast-uri (host confusion and SSRF), ip-address (SSRF via octet and IPv6 misclassification), qs (array-limit bypass, DoS). @huggingface/transformers 4.3.0 pulls sharp 0.35.5 and clears the libvips/libheif CVEs; verified against the exact API surface used in src/learning/embeddings.ts (pipeline, env.cacheDir, env.remoteHost). proxy-addr ^2.0.8 clears GHSA-jqcg-44mw-7w3h (IPv4-mapped IPv6 trust spoofing) inside express, which still accepts ^2.0.7. @modelcontextprotocol/sdk is a direct dependency pinned to ^1.32.1 (advisory range was <1.31.0, GHSA-6qxp-vccf-f47h).

permissions.filesystem: read workspace sources; write graphflow-out/, .graphflow/, .graphflow-cache/ in the workspace; global config ~/.graphflow.config.json (0600)
permissions.network: LLM provider APIs listed in disclosure.network, only when a provider is configured; huggingface.co only for the first semantic-embedding model download (mirrorable via HF_ENDPOINT; embeddingProvider 'fnv' avoids it entirely); indexing/context/compression need no network

manifest.description: Multi-agent mathematical problem-solving & verification frameworks for DeepSeek Harness — FOUR agent presets in one install: vibe-math-v2 (probability-driven, classic: qs.json + Propos knowledge base + explorer→solver→review/debate verdict), vibe-math-v3 (THIRD-generation, classic: paper-style Markdown knowledge base with Problems/Progress/Propos/Methods/Verified + planner-agent scheduling that decides the next N actions + universal theory/method invention library + agents write their own Markdown directly via a per-file write lock), and vibe-math-v4 (FOURTH-generation: persistent self-organizing resident subagents that message & meet to decide all tasks, verify only by unanimous consensus, /compact at a context threshold, and stop only when all agree the problem is solved), and vibe-math-v5 (FIFTH-generation research institute: an academician as the organizational centre who decomposes and ASSIGNS work and chairs meetings; permanent researchers who hold the vote and may hire/fire their own temp workers; temp workers with no vote; a group chat and meetings; a durable per-recipient mailbox; a compare-and-set task DAG; and a boolean m-vote consensus rule where an object enters Verified/ only when at least m voting members agree AND every one of them returns exactly 1 or exactly 0). Installing this bundle auto-installs all four presets (v1 was removed at v2.0.0). Each preset also writes a FINAL PAPER by default when its run concludes — and does so BEFORE the run is marked complete: on v4/v5 the team co-authors its parts, merges them, cross-reviews, and the editor named by paperEditor finalises; the output is Paper/<run or institute id>/{paper.md,paper.tex,paper.pdf when a LaTeX engine is detected,paper.meta.json,paper.log.md} (params finalPaper/paperFormat/paperLanguage/paperCompilePdf/paperLatexCommand, plus paperEditor on v4/v5; see docs/final-paper.md).

manifest.name: dsh-maintainer-doc-guard
manifest.description: Keeps a long agent turn answerable to the user's actual request: a standing maintainer-document reminder, two pre-execute gates (read a same-basename precedent before editing infrastructure; say what a side-effecting step is for), an objective anchor that quotes the user's latest instruction plus an explicit precedence rule, and a nudge stage that corrects before it blocks. Details: (1) A standing system-prompt section that tells the model to read the workspace maintainer documents (plan.md / conventions.md / stack.md / state.md / maintainer/README.md) before every operation, so small-model context compaction cannot erase long-term project memory. (2) A `tools/pre-execute` precedent gate that denies a write/edit inside a guarded infrastructure area until a working same-basename precedent has been read. (3) A `tools/pre-execute` intent gate that polices the turn's side-effecting calls when the model never said what the step is for. (4) An OBJECTIVE ANCHOR: the user's latest instruction, quoted verbatim in a second prompt section with an explicit precedence rule (user's latest instruction > your own last stated plan > a lead you found yourself), so a long turn cannot silently redefine its own task. (5) A NUDGE stage that corrects before it blocks — the first unexplained action only injects a reminder the model reads at its next step, a drift reminder fires once per long turn, and only a repeated offence is denied. Plus a right-sidebar tab that views and edits those documents, and ten runtime knobs exposed in the harness settings page (设置 → 插件 → 插件配置).

manifest.versionNote: 0.3.4：修四个影响真实使用的缺陷，中英文双语场景均覆盖。① 中文正文被吞进 URL：裸链正则只排除了 CJK 标点段（U+3000–U+303F）与全角段（U+FF00–U+FFEF），漏了汉字主体（U+4E00–U+9FFF），于是「详见 https://a.com/说明 结束」会把整句当成 URL，产出点不开的假来源 —— 中文不用空格分词，汉字必须作为定界符；同时补上假名、谚文、扩展 A/B 与兼容表意段。代价是未做百分号编码的中文路径会被截短，但那仍是可打开的地址。markdown 链接由 ) 定界，因此保留非 ASCII，中文维基类 URL 完整可用。② URL 收尾漏剥反引号与 markdown 强调记号：行内代码 `https://x` 会带上尾反引号，**粗体**/_斜体_ 同理，现一并剥离。③ truncated 硬编码为 false：官方语义是「来源列表被上限截断」，前端据此显示「来源列表已截断」；此前恒为 false，用户看不到截断提示。修的过程中又发现并修掉一个自引入缺陷：早先按「遍历时有没有 break」判断 capped，于是 20 条 markdown 链接占满后再丢弃裸链仍报 false —— 明明丢了来源却告诉前端没丢；现按去重后的候选总数判断，并让 markdown 链接优先。④ 未知加密算法版本被误报成「未登录」：parseEnvelope 只认 suite=1（刻意不猜未来格式），但 hasEncryptedFields 同时被当成「用户登没登录」的判据，于是 WorkBuddy 一旦升级加密算法，明明登录着的用户会收到「请去桌面端登录」—— 重登一百次也没用。现在区分「是不是加密凭据文档」与「能不能解开」，新增 WB_SEARCH_CREDENTIAL_UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT，错误信息直说格式比插件新并给出升级路径。⑤ 同一次开发中还修掉一个自引入的回归：只要有解不开的信封就整体判为不可用，于是「明文 accessToken + 未知格式 refreshToken」这种混合形态会被拒绝 —— 把「现在就能搜」变成「完全不能用」，比修复前更差。判据改为「确实拿不到可用 token」而非「存在解不开的信封」，T13.9/T13.10 锁住两侧边界。⑥ 未来算法版本的凭据必须仍被算作「有凭据」（T11.3b/T11.3c）：若只认可解析的信封，available() 会返回 false，宿主只给笼统的「provider 不可用」，用户就看不到「格式比插件新」这条可操作指引。另新增 38 条回归用例（T11/T12/T13），并用变异测试证明护栏非恒真：逐个注入上述旧行为，套件均如实失败。 ⑦ 独立审阅又找出四处，均已修并补测试：（a）「明文 accessToken + **合法但解不开**的 suite-1 refreshToken」仍被整体拒绝 —— 此前只在信封**解析失败**时放行明文 token，判据不一致；正确判据只有一个：最终 accessToken 是否为空（T13.11）。（b）损坏的信封被误报成「算法版本比插件新」，让用户去升级插件、提 Issue，而真正原因是文件损坏、重登即可；现拆出 WB_SEARCH_CREDENTIAL_MALFORMED（T13.12/T13.13）。（c）markdown 链接正则在第一个 `)` 处截断，维基百科消歧义页这类 URL（`.../Foo_(bar)`）变成括号不配对的死链（T12.4e）。（d）收尾清理无脑剥右括号，且裸链用 `(?<!\()` 避重，把「括号包裹的裸链」这种常见写法整条丢掉；现按括号是否配对决定剥离、按 markdown 实际区间避重（T12.4f/T12.4g）。 ⑧ 顺带消掉一个既有的二次复杂度：markdown 标题原用 `[^\]]*`，在**大量未闭合 `[`** 上是 O(n²)（8 万个 `[` 要 4 秒；真实综述里只有几十个 `[`，故一直没暴露）。给标题加 200 字符上界后降到线性（同样输入 24ms，约 165 倍），实测真实标题最长仅 20 字符，余量 10 倍（T12.15/T12.16）。

scripts.//check: Build runs BEFORE typecheck on purpose. Each adapter resolves the core through the `jevcore` workspace link, and the core's `types` entry is `lib/index.d.ts` — which does not exist until it is built. Typechecking first works on any machine that already has a `lib/` and fails on a clean checkout, which is exactly how CI caught it.
scripts.//check:workflows: Runs before build, beside the other gates that read committed text rather than build output. It exists because the trap it catches fired twice in this repository: bash performs command substitution on backticks inside a `run:` block before the program in that block sees the text, so a backtick written in a JavaScript comment inside `node -e "..."` is executed as a shell command. The first occurrence was diagnosed and documented in a NOTE; the second was added by the change that wrote this gate.
scripts.//check:docs: Runs BEFORE build, and reads no build output: it compares docs/ with the copies in packages/*/docs, both of which are committed. The placement is about repairs, which is what separates it from check:mojibake below. That gate's drift half has to run after the build because only a build clears a stale artifact, so running it earlier printed the same advisories on every un-rebuilt tree. Nothing in this chain clears a stale copy — `build` compiles TypeScript and never reads `docs/`, so a copy that is behind stays behind until someone runs the sync. Failing before a build that cannot help is therefore the cheap order, and it sits beside `legal` because it is the same kind of gate: a generated directory that `files[]` ships, asserted by its own `--check` mode and repaired by running its script.
scripts.//check:mojibake: Runs AFTER build, not before. Before it, every un-rebuilt edit made the chain print the same stale-artifact advisories; noise on the normal path is how a real finding gets skimmed past, and nothing ships on that path anyway — release.yml runs this whole chain, build included, before it publishes. After it, the corruption half scans the artifact the build just produced, and the drift half stays quiet unless a rebuild could not have fixed what it found.
scripts.check: pnpm run legal && pnpm run check:docs && pnpm run check:readmes && pnpm run check:workflows && pnpm run build && pnpm run check:mojibake && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test

manifest.name: @argszero/cordis-plugin-tool-deadline-guard
manifest.description: Deployment-level, phase-complete tool-call deadlines for dsh: a tool that never declares ToolDefinition.timeoutMs is dispatched with no deadline at all, so one wedged call (a delegation whose child never settles, a third-party MCP tool that never returns) leaves the turn running forever with nothing in the log to say why. Mounted on the public tools/execute and tools/pre-execute waterfalls, this plugin arms a configurable budget for exactly those phases, converts an expired one into a structured TOOL_DEADLINE_EXCEEDED result (or a TOOL_PRE_EXECUTE_DEADLINE_EXCEEDED denial, when the call was never dispatched) the model can see and retry, and leaves declared budgets, exempt tools and unknown tools untouched. Cooperative by default: it never abandons a call whose tool would not settle, and says so out loud in its optional replace mode instead. Peer ranges are audited to admit the same versions under npm and pnpm prerelease readings (dsh 0.1.2-rc.1 through 0.2.1-alpha.2).
